markingDesignNotes: Practical Section A contains drawn graph and uncertainty tasks; typed keyword marking alone cannot validate graphical evidence.
Source permits specific consequential credit between earlier and later calculations; record dependencies before playable adaptation.
Section B includes coherent sound sources, graph-area impulse and kinematics with alternative valid methods.
Section C consists of 30 separate one-mark multiple-choice items; original MCQ keys, options and wording are not copied.
Physics scheme's contradiction handling, appropriate significant figures, alternative routes and arithmetic-error penalties must be checked per adapted question.
Every topic label is an editorial candidate; no exact AQA specification code is independently verified.
No student-facing questions, official stems, official worked answers or copyrighted diagrams are included here.
